description: Haltestellen des ERZmobils is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Freistaat Sachsen. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
